system.description: A precise strike that impairs the victim's mobility. Gain +4 Acc on your attack. Your attack cannot gain Extra Attacks. On hit, target unit gains 'Restrained' for 1 turn. (Cannot Move and loses their Agi bonus to Eva and Agi Saving Throws)
A versatile spear that can be thrown at range.

Grant protection to an adjacent friendly unit. You move into that unit's square. The protected unit must be your size or smaller. While on top of that protected unit, it cannot be targeted by any hostile actions, including Area wide effects. 

This effect breaks when either you or the protected unit exit the same square.
A heavy suit of armor meant for standing sentries.
